newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwaiti investors are to build a tourist city in Egypt at a cost of $600 million.
- Iraqi dinar begins to rise on the Jordanian market after U.N. approves oil-for-food deal.
- Syria's gas consumption rose to 10 million cubic metres per day in 1995.
- Egypt produced medicines worth 3.1 billion pounds in 1995.
- A Saudi trade delegation ended a visit to Lebanon and signed contracts to export ceramics and glass.
- Japan granted Jordan $11.3 million to develop the water supply network in the capital Amman.
- Car sales were down 40 percent in Saudi Arabia in 1995.
